gap: By default, the keyboard focus indicator is the ripple or a background tint, and its contrast can fall below 3:1
workaround: Enable `focusVisible` in your theme — see below

gap: Some default palette colors fall short of contrast minimums
The selected state of colored Toggle Buttons is conveyed almost entirely by hue
workaround: Add a non-color cue to the selected state, such as an icon

gap: Links without an underline rely on color, and several palette colors are below 3:1 against body text
workaround: Keep the default `underline="always"` for links in body text

gap: Dynamic state changes are not announced

workaround: Show it only while an operation is in flight
